For each question, choose the correct answer.
What will cars be like in the future?
Cars today are nothing like the ones that were driven a century ago. So it's difficult to (21).................. what they'll be like 100 years from now. Because vehicles nowadays create a number of serious problems on our roads, it's likely that future cars will actually be very different.
It's certain that technology will strongly (22).................. the design of future cars, with computers becoming even more important. Some scientists and engineers are even (23).................. that in the future, there could be some kind of flying car, which will travel several metres above the ground!
Most people, however, agree that cars should (24).................. environmentally cleaner, so car companies are likely to (25).................. the engines we have now with ones that can use clean fuels and other (26).................. of green energy.

questions.explanation:
“难以想象 100 年后的汽车会是什么样子”，“imagine” 表示 “想象”，符合 “对未来事物的构想” 语境。
A. suppose（假设）侧重 “推测”，而非 “构想画面”；
B. realise（意识到）和 D. recognise（认出）均与 “想象未来” 的语义不符。
拓展：“imagine doing sth.” 为常见搭配，如 “imagine living in a flying car”（想象住在飞行汽车里）。

“科技将强烈影响未来汽车的设计”，“influence” 表示 “影响”，符合逻辑。
A. allow（允许）、B. involve（涉及）、C. persuade（说服）均无法体现 “科技对设计的作用”。
拓展：“have an influence on sth.” 为固定短语，如 “Technology has a huge influence on car industry”（科技对汽车行业影响巨大）。

“一些科学家和工程师甚至预测未来可能会有飞行汽车”，“predicting” 表示 “预测”，与 “未来场景” 呼应。
B. telling（告诉）、C. deciding（决定）、D. describing（描述）均不符合 “对未发生事物的判断” 语境。
拓展：“predict” 的名词形式为 “prediction”，如 “make a prediction about future cars”（对未来汽车做预测）。

“汽车应该变得更环保”，“become” 为系动词，后接形容词 “cleaner”，表示 “变得……”。
A. succeed（成功）、C. produce（生产）、D. achieve（实现）均不能直接接形容词，语法错误。
拓展：系动词后接形容词的常见搭配还有 “get better”（变得更好）、“stay healthy”（保持健康）。

“汽车公司可能会用清洁能源发动机替代现有发动机”，“replace...with...” 为固定搭配，意为 “用…… 替换……”。
A. remove（移除）需接 “from”；B. change（改变）需接 “into”；D. improve（改进）不与 “with” 搭配。
拓展：“replace” 强调 “以新代旧”，如 “replace old cars with electric ones”（用电动车替换旧车）。

“其他类型的绿色能源”，“types” 表示 “类型”，符合 “能源分类” 的语义。
B. ways（方式）、C. methods（方法）侧重 “做法”；D. styles（风格）多指 “设计样式”，均与 “能源种类” 不匹配。
拓展：“different types of energy” 为常见表达，如 “types of renewable energy”（可再生能源的类型）。
